title: Reported Speech: Basic
objectives: Say ve tell ile söylenen sözü aktarmak
Zaman kayması kurallarını uygulamak (am → was, will → would, can → could)
Zamir ve zaman ifadelerini değiştirmek (my → his, tomorrow → the next day)

sections.title: Reported Speech nedir?
paragraphs: Reported speech (dolaylı anlatım), birinin söylediği sözü doğrudan alıntılamadan aktarmaktır. Direct speech: “I am tired,” she said. Reported speech: She said she was tired. Türkçedeki “-dığını söyledi” yapısına karşılık gelir.
Aktarırken genellikle zaman bir adım geriye kayar (backshift), zamirler ve zaman ifadeleri değişir. Bu derste özneli ifadeleri (statements) ve say / tell kullanımını öğreneceksin.

sections.title: Say ve tell
paragraphs: Say’den sonra doğrudan söylenen söz gelir; kişi gerekiyorsa to ile eklenir (say to me). Tell’den sonra mutlaka kişi gelir (tell me). Tell’de to kullanılmaz.

formulas.label: Say
formulas.pattern: say (that) + cümle   /   say to + kişi (that) + cümle

sections.title: Zaman kayması (backshift)
paragraphs: Aktaran fiil geçmiş zamandaysa (said, told) cümle bir zaman geriye kayar:

forms.label: Present Simple → Past Simple
forms.formula: “I like pizza.” → He said he liked pizza.

forms.label: Present Continuous → Past Continuous
forms.formula: “I’m watching TV.” → She said she was watching TV.

forms.label: Past Simple → Past Perfect
forms.formula: “I visited Paris.” → He said he had visited Paris.

forms.label: Present Perfect → Past Perfect
forms.formula: “I have finished.” → She said she had finished.

forms.label: will → would
forms.formula: “I will call you.” → He said he would call me.

forms.label: can → could
forms.formula: “I can swim.” → She said she could swim.

forms.label: must → had to, may → might
forms.formula: “I must go.” → He said he had to go.

sections.title: Zamir ve zaman ifadelerinin değişmesi
paragraphs: Aktaran kişinin bakış açısına göre zamirler ve zaman / yer ifadeleri değişir.

formulas.label: Zamirler
formulas.pattern: I → he / she,   my → his / her,   we → they,   me → him / her

formulas.label: Zaman
formulas.pattern: today → that day,  tomorrow → the next day,  yesterday → the day before

sections.title: Olumsuz cümleler
paragraphs: Olumsuzlar da aynı kayma kuralını izler: don’t → didn’t, can’t → couldn’t, won’t → wouldn’t.

formulas.label: Olumsuz
formulas.pattern: don’t → didn’t;  can’t → couldn’t;  won’t → wouldn’t

sections.title: Zaman kaymasının olmadığı durumlar
paragraphs: Aktaran fiil şimdiki zamandaysa (says, tells) ya da söylenen genel doğru / hâlâ geçerli bir durumsa kayma gerekmez.

formulas.label: Genel doğru
formulas.pattern: The teacher said the Earth is round.

items.wrong: She said she is tired. (olay geçmişte)
items.explanation: Geçmiş aktarımda zaman bir adım geri.

items.wrong: He told that he was busy.
items.right: He told me that he was busy.

items.wrong: He said me he was busy.
items.right: He said to me he was busy. / He told me he was busy.

items.wrong: He told to me he was busy.
items.right: He told me he was busy.

items.wrong: He said he will call me.
items.right: He said he would call me.

items.body: Have + V3 aktarımda had + V3 olur.

sections.title: Dikkat edilecekler
items: Said / told geçmiş olduğunda cümle bir zaman geriye kayar.
Zamir ve zaman ifadeleri bakış açısına göre değişir.
Says gibi şimdiki zamanda ve genel doğrularda kayma gerekmez.

examples.en: "I am tired," she said. → She said (that) she was tired.
"I like pizza," he said. → He said (that) he liked pizza.
"We live in Ankara," they said. → They said (that) they lived in Ankara.
"I work here," he said. → He said he worked here.
"I'm watching TV," she said. → She said she was watching TV.
"We are playing," they said. → They said they were playing.
"I visited Paris," he said. → He said he had visited Paris.
"I have finished," she said. → She said she had finished.
"I will call you," he said. → He said he would call me.
"I can swim," she said. → She said she could swim.
"I must go," he said. → He said he had to go.
"I may come," she said. → She said she might come.
He said, "I like you." → He told me he liked me.
She told me she was tired.
They told us they were leaving.
He said he was busy.
He said to me that he was busy.
She said she didn't know.
He said he couldn't come.
"I love my job," he said. → He said he loved his job.
"I'm going home," she said. → She said she was going home.
"I'll see you tomorrow," he said. → He said he would see me the next day.
"I'm busy today," she said. → She said she was busy that day.
"I saw him yesterday," he said. → He said he had seen him the day before.
"I live here," she said. → She said she lived there.
"I want this," he said. → He said he wanted that.
She says she is tired. (şimdiki: shift yok)
examples.note: Reporting verb şimdiki zamanda: shift yok

examples.en: "The Earth is round," the teacher said. → The teacher said the Earth is round.
